title: ElixirConf 2019 - Day 1 Morning Keynote - Brian Cardarella, Luke Imhoff, Paul Schoenfelder
summary: The ElixirConf 2019 day 1 morning keynote, including the announcement of Lumen, an alternative BEAM implementation designed for WebAssembly. It features DockYard's team presenting the project and a demo.
why: HN links it as the original announcement of Lumen (later Firefly), for people wanting technical detail on the project.
